name: Ziph
line: Ziph was a city in the hill country of Judah, and the wilderness near it is where David hid from King Saul.

moments.title: David Hides in Ziph
moments.text: David stayed in the safe hiding places in the hill country of the Wilderness of Ziph. Saul searched for him day after day, but God did not let Saul catch David.

moments.title: Jonathan Encourages David
moments.text: While David was in Horesh in the Wilderness of Ziph, Jonathan came and helped him trust God. He told David he would be king, and the two made a promise before the LORD.

moments.title: Saul Hunts in Ziph
moments.text: The Ziphites told Saul that David was hiding near them. Saul took three thousand chosen men down to the Wilderness of Ziph to search for David there.

moments.title: Rehoboam Strengthens Ziph
moments.text: Rehoboam made the walls and defenses of Ziph and other cities of Judah and Benjamin stronger. He put officers in them, with supplies of food, oil, and wine.
